title.purpose: Heading of the section in Details that suggests which Library tracks to play after the selected one.

loading.purpose: Says the suggestions are being worked out.

none.purpose: Says no Library track can be suggested after the selected one, so it isn't read as a fault.
none.where: What's next section, when the list is empty.

considered_one.purpose: Says how many Library tracks were compared (one).
considered_one.where: What's next section, under the list.

considered_other.purpose: Says how many Library tracks were compared.
considered_other.where: What's next section, under the list.

direction.label.purpose: Name of the choice of which way the energy should go from the selected track.
direction.label.where: What's next section, beside the Up, Same and Down choices.

direction.up.purpose: Choice: suggest tracks with higher energy.

direction.same.purpose: Choice: suggest tracks with about the same energy.

direction.down.purpose: Choice: suggest tracks with lower energy.

reason.separator.purpose: Joins a suggestion's reasons into one line.
reason.separator.where: What's next section, after each suggested track.

reason.keySame.purpose: Reason: the suggested track has the same key as the selected one. {{key}} is the key.

reason.keyAdjacent.purpose: Reason: the key is one number up or down on the Camelot wheel, same letter. {{from}} and {{to}} are keys.

reason.keyRelative.purpose: Reason: the key is the relative major or minor (same number, other letter). {{from}} and {{to}} are keys.

reason.keyTwoSteps.purpose: Reason (wide tolerance only): the key is two numbers away on the wheel. {{from}} and {{to}} are keys.

reason.keyDiagonal.purpose: Reason (wide tolerance only): the key is one number away and the other letter. {{from}} and {{to}} are keys.

reason.keyFar.purpose: Reason: the key is not next to the selected track's. {{from}} and {{to}} are keys.

reason.keyNone.purpose: Reason: the suggested track has no key.

reason.bpm.purpose: Reason: the BPM difference from the selected track, with sign. {{delta}} is the signed number.

reason.bpmSame.purpose: Reason: the BPM is the same as the selected track's.

reason.bpmHalf.purpose: Reason: the BPM counts at half the selected track's tempo. {{bpm}} is the BPM reason.

reason.bpmDouble.purpose: Reason: the BPM counts at double the selected track's tempo. {{bpm}} is the BPM reason.

reason.bpmNone.purpose: Reason: the suggested track has no BPM.

reason.energyStep.purpose: Reason: the energy step from the selected track, with sign. {{step}} is the signed number.

reason.energySame.purpose: Reason: the energy is the same as the selected track's.

reason.energyNone.purpose: Reason: the suggested track has no energy, which is why it comes after tracks that have one.

reason.playedAfter_one.purpose: Reason: the user has played this track right after the selected one, once.

reason.playedAfter_other.purpose: Reason: the user has played this track right after the selected one, several times. {{count}} is how many.

reason.genreSame.purpose: Reason: the suggested track has the same genre as the selected one. {{genre}} is the genre.

reason.genreRelated.purpose: Reason: the suggested track's genre sits next to the selected track's in the genre tree (same parent, or one is the other's parent). {{from}} and {{to}} are genres.

reason.tagsShared_one.purpose: Reason: the suggested track has the one tag of the selected track's that is named. {{tags}} is the tag.

reason.tagsShared_other.purpose: Reason: the suggested track shares several tags with the selected one. {{tags}} is the list of tags.

reason.similar.purpose: Reason: the audio model hears the suggested track as sounding like the selected one. {{percent}} is how alike, as a whole percent. Labelled as the audio model's opinion; it only ever appears beside a reason from the track's facts.

ignored.label.purpose: Says which signals could not be used because the selected track lacks that information. {{signals}} is a list.
ignored.label.where: What's next section, under the list.

ignored.separator.purpose: Joins the names of the signals that could not be used.
ignored.separator.where: What's next section, under the list.

ignored.similar.modelOff.purpose: Says the sounds-similar signal has a weight but is not counted because the audio model is switched off.
ignored.similar.modelOff.where: What's next section, under the list; only when its weight is above 0.

ignored.similar.noFingerprint.purpose: Says the sounds-similar signal has a weight but is not counted because the audio model has no fingerprint for the selected track yet (not listened to, or it could not be read).
ignored.similar.noFingerprint.where: What's next section, under the list; only when its weight is above 0 and the audio model is on.

signal.key.purpose: Name of the key signal, in the list of signals not used.

signal.bpm.purpose: Name of the BPM signal, in the list of signals not used.

signal.energy.purpose: Name of the energy signal, in the list of signals not used.

signal.played.purpose: Name of the play history signal, in the list of signals not used.

signal.genre.purpose: Name of the genre signal, in the list of signals not used.

signal.tags.purpose: Name of the tags signal, in the list of signals not used.

signal.similar.purpose: Name of the sounds-similar signal, in the list of signals not used.

weights.title.purpose: Heading of the panel where the weights and the tolerance are shown and changed.
weights.title.where: What's next section, a collapsed panel.

weights.hint.purpose: Explains the weights: 0 turns a signal off, 10 is the most, changes apply at once.
weights.hint.where: What's next section, in the weights panel.

weights.key.purpose: Label of the weight for key compatibility.

weights.bpm.purpose: Label of the weight for BPM closeness.

weights.energy.purpose: Label of the weight for the energy step.

weights.played.purpose: Label of the weight for tracks the user has played after the selected one.

weights.genre.purpose: Label of the weight for tracks in the same genre, or one next to it, as the selected track. Off (0) until the user turns it up.

weights.tags.purpose: Label of the weight for tags the suggested track shares with the selected one.

weights.similar.purpose: Label of the weight for how alike the audio model hears a suggested track and the selected one. 1 by default once the audio model is switched on; it never counts alone, only beside a fact like key or BPM.

weights.tolerance.label.purpose: Name of the choice between tight and wide tolerance.

weights.tolerance.tight.purpose: Choice: only close matches count (the same limits as Sort by fit).

weights.tolerance.wide.purpose: Choice: bigger jumps in key, BPM and energy still count.

weights.tolerance.hint.where: Weights panel, under the tolerance choice.
